Morning team — quick request as we prepare the month-end forecast: 

Attached is a one-sheet export (pipeline-inventory-20250915.csv) showing all open opportunities at or beyond 60 days in close-date drift and any stage labeled "Commit" without supporting evidence.

Asks:
- AE owners (cc'd): please confirm each opportunity you own by EOD Wednesday 9/17 — either 1) certify the close date & attach a short proof doc (contract email, signed SOW, PO) or 2) move to the correct stage (Discovery/Negotiation/On Hold) and add a 1-line rationale.
- Finance contact at StellarHealth (finance@stellarhealth.com): if you expect any PO timing changes for deals where StellarHealth is the payer, please reply so we can reflect in the forecast.

Notes: we will apply a conservative recognition rule for any opportunity without evidence after 9/17. We want to avoid surprise misses in next week's projection.

Attachment: pipeline-inventory-20250915.csv (snapshot)

Thanks — Irene
